analysis.executive_summary: Audit crawled 998 pages from Courier.com documentation with 100% crawl coverage across 1,286 discovered pages. API reference coverage stands at 62.7% across 238 detected API pages, while only 29.66% of pages display last-updated metadata. Overall confidence score is 63.5%, with link verification confidence notably low at 25% due to 232 unverified URLs blocked by authentication or rate limiting.
